scope: Original S013, S027, S032 for all 13 SQL parser dialects; bounded physical-source evidence, not non-DuckDB vendor execution or independent signoff.

cases.original_sql: SELECT o.id FROM orders o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customers c WHERE c.id = o.id)
cases.portable_semantics: EXISTS is TRUE iff at least one inner row has a TRUE non-NULL equality with the current outer row. It is FALSE otherwise; never UNKNOWN. Inner duplicates do not duplicate outer rows.
cases.bounded_exactness: exact with complete authoritative two-source populations, unique physical occurrence identities distinct from SQL values, exact signed integer key types and directly normalized equality; selected and NOT TRUE bags plus NULL/duplicate partition are complete
cases.open_world_disposition: residual is necessary without a complete inner relation; an attested empty inner relation is Exact with zero selected rows. Never infer absence from a partial inner sample.

cases.original_sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE amount + 2 > 10
cases.portable_semantics: Signed integer addition followed by ordered comparison; input SQL NULL yields UNKNOWN, and positive/negative row multiplicities are preserved.
cases.bounded_exactness: exact for one complete schema-validated physical source with a declared signed 16/32/64-bit amount and every evaluated amount+2 representable within that declared width; no wider vendor result assumed
cases.open_world_disposition: unbounded signed source can overflow its own width; DuckDB BIGINT widening does not certify other vendor result-width rules. If any source value can overflow, retain named residual and route portable vendor laws to TASK-179.

cases.original_sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE ABS(amount) > 2
cases.portable_semantics: Signed integer ABS followed by ordered comparison; input SQL NULL yields UNKNOWN, and negative values test magnitude without changing source row identity.
cases.bounded_exactness: exact for one complete schema-validated physical source with signed 16/32/64-bit amount and no row whose magnitude is outside the signed source width (in particular, no signed minimum). Full TRUE/NOT TRUE/UNKNOWN and terminal bags are returned.
cases.open_world_disposition: ABS(min_signed_value) may overflow or error. Even an exact finite safe bag cannot establish a portable native engine law for arbitrary new source rows. Preserve named residual unless source safety and result width are proved; TASK-179 owns native vendor law.
